Have video of a 100 meter sprint or any other event and want to know the precise elapsed time of the event after the video was recorded? Maybe you want to measure the time it takes for an object to fall?

Enter Video Stopwatch. Just load your video into Video Stopwatch and scrub to the point you want and set the exact starting and ending point(s) to measure. You can also add many split times. Record high frame-rate video using the included camera for increased accuracy.

Video Stopwatch features a live stopwatch overlay on your video that can be moved and sized to your liking. The live stopwatch overlay will display your marked times precisely as the video is played. Save the video and share it with your friends.

Use Video Stopwatch for any kind of measurement captured on video in which you would like to calculate precise elapsed times. The uses are endless!
